I have only 0.08 hectares of beans behind the house, mostly for my family to eat. Last season I put cow manure on it and the plants did well, so I will do that again. I will not buy chemical fertilizer for such a small plot — one bag is too much and too costly, and I need what little cash I have for the maize plot. I will plant the beans I saved from last year, and my wife and children will handle the weeding and harvesting. We do not need to hire anyone for a plot this small.
